items.question: Can you review my conference presentation for me?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Can you review my conference presentation for me?”，自然应答是“Sure, send it to me.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（Sure, send it to me.）。
